title: Guster hub manifest
description: Format contract for hub.yaml, the Guster hub manifest. Field semantics follow src/guster/layout.py and src/guster/hub.py. Guster reads values in their string form, so quoted and unquoted spellings of schema_version are equivalent.

schema_version.description: Manifest format major version; absent means 1.

profile.description: Hub profile; any other value draws a `hub validate` warning.

hub_version.description: Version of the hub's own contract; informational, shown by `hub status`.

min_guster.description: Minimum guster CLI version this hub needs; compared numerically by dotted segments.

created_at.description: ISO date the hub was created.

paths.description: Declared hub sections. Relative values are hub-relative and must not contain '..'; a hub may also declare external sections with absolute or ~/ paths. Schema 2 must declare knowledge and projects.

waivers.description: Silence a finding; every waiver must carry a written reason.

rule.description: Rule name of the waived finding, e.g. broken-pointer; the name a doctor finding reports, not the CTX spec id.

path.description: Optional scope; only findings for this path are waived.

reason.description: Written justification; a waiver without one fails loud.
